meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让系统自动跑实验,持续优化代码与模型效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你总在反复调参做实验,希望系统自动帮你找到更好的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run iterative experiments to keep improving your code and model results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of manually tweaking models and want the system to find the best approach for you

howto.what: Claude 会把你给的工件(代码、配置、提示词等)当作优化对象,自动反复做实验:维护一棵“假设树”记录每个猜想与结果,派子代理在隔离 git 工作区测试,只有通过独立测试集评估的改动才会被合并。最后产出改进版工件、测试得分和实验报告。
howto.when: 当你想把一个具体工件(如模型评测分数、智能体或流水线)反复改进、跑很多实验又怕过拟合时触发;即使你不提 Arbor,只要描述“反复实验—评估”的循环、比较多个思路或担心训练/测试集差距,也会触发。

say.text: 帮我把模型在开发集上的分数提上去,但别过拟合。
say.note: Claude 会建立假设树,分派子代理开始实验。

say.text: 优化这个数据处理流水线,用独立测试集把关每次改动。
say.note: 通过测试集评估的改动才会被合并。

say.text: 像做 MLE-bench 那样优化我的提交,保留评分最高的方案。
say.note: Claude 会对比候选方案,只合并测试通过的。

howto.what_en: Claude runs autonomous optimization: a persistent hypothesis tree, executor subagents in isolated git worktrees, and a held-out test gate for merging only changes that pass it. Output: improved artifact plus audit report.
howto.when_en: Triggers on iterative improvement of a concrete artifact under an evaluator, even if 'Arbor' isn't said; also on repeated experiment-evaluate loops, competing hypotheses, or dev/test split worries.

say_en.text: Help me raise my model's dev-set score without overfitting.
say_en.note: Claude builds a hypothesis tree and dispatches subagents.

say_en.text: Improve this data pipeline, gating every change with a held-out test set.
say_en.note: Only changes that pass the test evaluator get merged.

say_en.text: Optimize my submission like an MLE-bench task and keep the best approach.
say_en.note: Claude compares candidates and merges only test-passing ones.
